prompt_en: Create a photographic winter fashion portrait of a woman in winter clothing at a sheltered ferry boarding threshold after a coastal snow squall. Her visible face and hair follow the supplied image as appearance guidance. Her dark chin-length bob and wispy bangs frame a softly alert face; she lifts her eyes toward the newly illuminated amber boarding lamp, lips relaxing slightly after the wait. Her winter clothing is visibly readable in one continuous figure. She wears a navy wool duffle coat reaching just above the knees. Its generous hood is sewn into this coat's neckline directly above the toggle row and rests behind her head; dense cream pile is sewn around the hood's opening and around each sleeve cuff, with a clear navy fabric border connecting every strip to the coat. Three horizontal wooden toggles and their thick rope loops sit on opposite front edges. The upper toggle is threaded across the rope loop to connect the two coat fronts; the two lower toggles hang beside their unfastened loops. The open lower front reveals a separate ochre sleeveless quilted liner vest with shallow diamond-stitched cells, its own narrow front edges and hem. Beneath the vest is a cream ribbed roll-neck sweater; its ribbed tube folds over into a high collar around her neck, while the sweater fabric at her waist continues below the vest's hem. The coat sleeve is visibly outside the cream knit sleeve at each wrist. These are three independently bounded garments with readable boundaries and a practical winter silhouette. A low cedar crate of wrapped greenhouse cuttings sits on a waist-high luggage ledge at her left. Her left hand rests on the crate's near rim while the crate's base is supported by the ledge; her right arm hangs clear of the coat front, with the relaxed hand beside her thigh. Both feet stand apart on the flat sheltered threshold, torso upright and slightly turned toward the water, shoulders lowered. The amber lamp and an open boarding gate give her raised gaze a destination. Snow still clings to the crate's lid and outside railing; a meltwater track ends at her boots, marking where she just arrived. Beyond the gate, the ferry's warm entry window glows through blue dusk. Photograph from mid-chest height in a near-frontal three-quarter view, including her head, both wrists, coat hem, crate and boots in a vertical frame. The face is the first point of attention, followed by the distinct winter layers and closures; the crate and boarding lamp complete the pause. Cold diffuse sky light retains navy wool texture, rope fibers, stitched quilting and individual cream pile fibers. A gentle warm spill from the terminal door touches her cheek and hand. Moderate depth preserves her face as a readable plane, the resting hand and its contact on the crate's rim, and the ferry gate as a recognizable setting cue. Her composed warmth and tactile clothes create a quiet everyday attraction within the observed moment.
